blocks.text: Let's solve this one step by step. Solve three times the quantity x minus two equals twelve. Type the value of x.
Distribute the three: three times x is three x, and three times two is six. The distributive property gives three x minus six.
Add six to both sides, by the addition property of equality. Three x equals eighteen.
Divide both sides by three, by the division property of equality. X equals six.
Watch out for these traps. If you subtract six instead of adding it, you get two. If you stop before the last division, you get eighteen.
